trigger_evidence.observation: Exact Ribasim v2026.1.1 rejects finite solver.saveat=8.64 because finite saveat must be an integer number of seconds.
trigger_evidence.source_contract: core/src/config.jl convert_saveat: finite saveat != round(saveat) is invalid

amendment.amended_semantics: save only start and end of the 8.64-second model horizon

authority_basis: RM01/20D: allocation.dt, not solver.saveat, owns fixed UserDemand management cadence in the tested product route.
RM03/RM12: saveat is not a competing allocation clock and explicit coupler-owned boundaries determine management execution.
Inf saveat is an explicitly supported exact-release configuration that writes the simulation start and end.
prohibition: Do not use this amendment to change any physical duration, management boundary, allocation expectation, supply expectation, groundwater envelope or numerical acceptance tolerance.
disposition: The original 8.64-second finite saveat is an invalid fixture encoding, not a scientific falsification of the RM13 three-model composition hypothesis.
